name: Live Nation Entertainment

hero_kpi_rationale: Le segment Concerts représente 83% du chiffre d'affaires de Live Nation et définit sa trajectoire. Ses revenus offrent l'historique 5 ans le plus lisible, du creux COVID 2021 au record 2025.

kpis.explanation: Revenus du segment Concerts (promotion d'événements live, salles, festivals), le coeur de métier de Live Nation.

kpis.signal_en: Record Concerts segment revenue, 83% of total

kpis.explanation: Nombre total de spectateurs ayant assisté aux concerts Live Nation dans le monde sur l'année.

kpis.explanation: Nombre de billets générant des frais vendus via Ticketmaster, métrique clé du segment Billetterie.

kpis.explanation: Revenus du segment Sponsoring et Publicité (droits de naming, partenariats, publicité sur site), segment à haute marge.

kpis.explanation_en: Sponsorship & Advertising segment revenue (naming rights, partnerships, on-site advertising), a high-margin segment.

kpis.explanation: Revenus du segment Billetterie via Ticketmaster (frais de service, billets primaires et secondaires).

kpis.explanation: Résultat opérationnel ajusté (non-GAAP) du segment Concerts, mesure de rentabilité suivie par la direction.

company_description: Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. operates as a live entertainment company worldwide. The company operates through Concerts, Ticketing, and Sponsorship & Advertising segments. Its Concerts segment promotes live music events in its owned or operated venues, and in rented third-party venues. This segment operates and manages music venues; produces music festivals; creates associated content; and offers management and other services to artists. The Ticketing segment manages the ticketing operations, including the provision of ticketing software and services to consumers with marketplace for tickets and event information through mobile apps, other websites, and retail outlets, as well as its websites, such as livenation.com and ticketmaster.com; and provides ticket resale services. This segment offers ticketing services for arenas, stadiums, amphitheaters, music clubs, concert promoters, professional sports franchises and leagues, college sports teams, performing arts venues, museums, and theaters. Its Sponsorship & Advertising segment sells international, national, and local sponsorships and placement of advertising, including signage, online advertising, and promotional programs; rich
